changes_vs_current: Seinfeld, Simpsons, Parks, I Love Lucy, Arrested Development, Curb, Office rise to the top 7 (Friends falls from 3rd to 18th, Cheers from 9th to 17th). Added: BoJack Horseman, Dick Van Dyke Show, Andy Griffith Show, Larry Sanders, South Park, Veep, All in the Family, Mary Tyler Moore, The Good Place. Dropped: Modern Family, How I Met Your Mother, Fresh Prince, Everybody Loves Raymond, Scrubs, Abbott Elementary, New Girl, That '70s Show.
confidence: low-medium: only 3 usable full lists, two are critic panels and the third (IMDb) is genre-filtered and includes cartoons, which ranks Cheers 89th and omits M*A*S*H, All in the Family and Mary Tyler Moore from its top 100 (scored 105 each). That distorts the middle: BoJack, Dick Van Dyke and Andy Griffith are likely too high for a general-audience game, and Friends/Modern Family/HIMYM too low. Friends and Scrubs ranks in Paste could not be verified (page prints '17' and '20', which collide with other entries); Friends was scored 60 and Scrubs 63 in Paste, and Friends makes the top 24 either way (rank 9 if Paste truly has it 17th). Ranker (the large fan vote) was unreachable. YouGov had no sitcom-only ranking I could read. Consider re-running with a Ranker/YouGov read or dropping the IMDb source.
